messages:
incident-bot: *PAGER* org=prismaticsurge — sustained QPS spike, token-side saturation, errors rising to 5% on gen endpoints. oncall: @mira
mira (on-call): got it. looking at dashboards. can someone confirm which org-rate policy is applied? :eyes:
ash (infra): prismaticsurge is on org-plan 'growth', default RL=120RPM/org, per-user 60RPM. seeing bursts to ~180RPM/org for last 10m. shard 3 showing increased tail latency.
devon (account): customer reported a rollout that increased parallelism. they pushed a batch job at 12:18 PDT — might be the cause. flagged them via intercom.
mira (on-call): impact: 502s and 429s for a subset of users, approx 6% of requests. customer-facing features degraded (autocomplete + summaries).
kate (sre lead): @mira we should do an emergency org RL bump to 400RPM for prismaticsurge for 30m and monitor. roll back if errors fall below 1% and latency recovers.
samir (support): FYI customer contacts are now on a support call, they're seeing lots of user retries. they asked for a quick mitigation.
ash (infra): I can apply a transient override via control plane. command:
```
# apply emergency override
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/rl/overrides \n -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \n -d '{"org_id":"prismaticsurge","rate_limit":400,"scope":"org","expires_in":1800,"reason":"emergency qps spike"}'
```
mira (on-call): do it. we need telemetry alerting and post-change checklists. add tracing sample for prismaticsurge requests.
deployer-bot: override request received: id=o-9f2a. initiating change on control plane... :gear:
ash (infra): override applied on edge-proxies. TTL=1800s. verifying...
kate (sre lead): watch the error budget and 95th latency. set quick alerts: error_rate>2% or p95>800ms -> auto rollback.
mira (on-call): monitoring: error_rate fell from 5.2% -> 1.1% in ~2m. p95 from 950ms -> 420ms. good signal.
devon (account): telling customer we applied a temporary bump, asking them to roll back the batch job. they're grateful.
billing-bot: note: emergency override applied; this will incur overage charges and will be billed against prismaticsurge account. tag applied: 'emergency-override-2456789012'.
ash (infra): adding cache-ttl suggestion on their SDK to reduce burstiness. also recommending rate limiter throttling on client side.
mira (on-call): log snippets from proxy showing acceptance after change:
```
PROXY o=prismaticsurge accepted request id=3701 latency=120ms
PROXY o=prismaticsurge accepted request id=3702 latency=210ms
```
kate (sre lead): schedule: we'll keep override for 30m unless metrics worsen. after that we either expire or transition to a graduated RL (300RPM) while working with customer.
samir (support): customer will perform a controlled backoff of the batch job now.
mira (on-call): alerting: set a follow-up alarm at +25m to review. creating incident task to document timeline and RCA owner.
devon (account): assigning post-incident action: review onboarding for rate-limited operations; add a doc to account playbook.
mira (on-call): final note: no further real-time mitigation required. removing page for on-call. will hand off to SRE shifts for postmortem.
kate (sre lead): thanks all — please add any logs or screenshots to the incident ticket INC-2456789012. follow-up: evaluate whether org default RL should be raised for similar profiles.
incident-bot: incident archived to INC-2456789012 by @kate. timeline saved. :white_check_mark:
